Shop & Craft

Product Designs

Small product builds and handmade gifts — a hand-sewn backpack, a wooden pull toy, an origami-inspired chair, and jewelry.

Projects

Bag

A fully hand-sewn roll-top dry bag backpack. Constructed from a discarded dry bag and retired climbing rope, this bag is water tight, fully repurposed materials, and can haul loads of gear to the crag, up a mountain, through the canyons, or down a river.

Spider Pull Toy

A wood pull toy with articulating legs, designed from hand-drawn 1:1 scale sketches through to a painted final build.

Origami-Inspired Chair

A faceted chair design developed from small scale cardboard models through to a full-scale plywood build.

Jewelry

Handmade jewelry combining dark rose wood with abalone shell inlay.
